set -euo pipefail

INSTALL_MARKER="${SERVER_DIR}/.vnh_installed"
mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}"
cd "${SERVER_DIR}"

if [[ -f "${INSTALL_MARKER}" ]]; then
    echo "[VNH][INSTALL] Reinstall detected for Vietnam Hosting — FastAPI Hosting (Uvicorn). Preserving user data."
    VNH_REINSTALL=1
else
    echo "[VNH][INSTALL] First-time installation for Vietnam Hosting — FastAPI Hosting (Uvicorn)."
    VNH_REINSTALL=0
fi

# Safe HTTPS Git deployment without logging credentials or wiping existing user data

        echo "[VNH][INSTALL][ERROR] GIT_ADDRESS must use https:// scheme." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    if [[ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
        ASKPASS_FILE="$(mktemp /tmp/vnh-git-askpass.XXXXXX)"
        chmod 700 "${ASKPASS_FILE}"
        cat > "${ASKPASS_FILE}" <<'VNH_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env sh
case "$1" in
    *Username*) printf '%s\n' "${USERNAME:-git}" ;;
    *Password*) printf '%s\n' "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ;;
esac

        export GIT_ASKPASS="${ASKPASS_FILE}"
        export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0

        fi

        rm -rf "${CLONE_TMP}"
    fi

    if [[ -n "${ASKPASS_FILE}" ]]; then
        rm -f "${ASKPASS_FILE}"
        unset GIT_ASKPASS
    fi
